name: Rizzler Mogger
text: I would strongly recommend Oscar and Carlos. They both did furniture painting for me, it was an old piece of furniture and it came out beautiful. Cleanup was excellent!

name: Cyndi Herrmann
text: I used Brushline for a small job.  But they treated  me as if my job was super important.  Oscar gave a good price and completed my Sheetrock job to perfection… they were awesome - I highly recommend them for big or small jobs !

name: jake Winthrop
text: Very good looking work doing drywall repair on my ceiling, guarded all of my belongings from dust/ debris despite my home already being a construction site. Left the work area cleaner than they found it and very easy to work with. Would hire again

name: Guesline Morisseau
text: Excellent furniture assembly service! He assembled my dresser quickly and professionally everything is sturdy, looks great, I highly recommend brushline painting & home improvement. Thank you!

name: William Spalding
text: Brushline did an amazing job on the exterior of the house and the kitchen cabinets and backsplash. I never thought the old kitchen could look so amazing at a fraction of the cost of new cabinets. They painted the exterior including the lanai making it like new. Our home is 40 years old and needs total upgrades and I'm going to have them do the entire interior. Extremely pleased.

name: Rogelio Nunez
text:
I honestly couldn’t be happier with the work Brushline Painting & Home Improvements did. I hired them to repair a few holes in my apartment walls from TV mounts and picture frames before moving out.

My biggest concern was the wall texture. I was worried the patches would be obvious and that the apartment complex would charge me for repairs. But these guys absolutely nailed it. They matched the existing texture so well that you can barely tell where the holes were. I was genuinely impressed with the attention to detail.

They were also very professional, worked quickly, and charged a fair price. Thanks to the quality of their work, the apartment complex accepted the repairs, refunded my security deposit, and didn’t charge me any additional fees.

If you’re looking for someone who does quality drywall repairs and can perfectly match textured walls, I definitely recommend Brushline Painting & Home Improvements. They made the whole process easy and saved me a lot of money in the end.

name: Joseph Oneto
text: Oscar was professional proficient and unbeatable. He priced the job in one day, came early, and beat out all other competitor’s prices. Brushline Services can’t be beat.  I’ll use him again.
